LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.0.label: First Frost
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.0.description: Retains the chosen Frost evolution. Refinement: its 39-point damage effect. Relic awakenings are unaffected. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.1.label: Rime
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.1.description: Three ordinary hits mark the third hit’s victim with rime for 4 seconds, up to two victims. Cooldown: 3 seconds. A 4-second gap between eligible hits resets progress. Bonus damage and abilities do not count. Later branches spend rime; the mark itself adds no slow. Refinement gradually extends newly applied marks from 4 seconds toward 4.76 seconds, rounded to game ticks. Hit count, cooldown, target limit and one-use consumption remain unchanged; existing deadlines are preserved. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: mark duration ×1.5.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.2.label: Ice Mantle
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.2.description: Casting your Frost ability grants a separate 50-point personal shield for 3 seconds. Cooldown: 6 seconds. The layer does not stack with itself or alter ability cooldown. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.3.label: Shatter
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.3.description: A Frost ability hit spends the victim’s rime mark for 75 extra damage, at most once per second per victim. No mark means no bonus. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.4.label: Freeze a Beat
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.4.description: An ordinary hit on a rimed enemy warming up an ordinary weapon attack spends rime to extend that warmup by 0.2 seconds, once per mark. No eligible warmup leaves the original mark deadline intact; no extra stun is added. The mark is still spent once. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: control duration ×1.75.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.5.label: Ice Edge
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.5.description: After Ice Mantle absorbs enemy damage, remember the latest attacker for 3 seconds. Your ordinary hit within 2 cells returns the absorbed amount, up to 50 damage, once per shield round without renewal. A smaller absorbed budget is returned unchanged. The same shield round can still pay only once. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.6.label: Shared Cold
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.6.description: A real Ice Mantle grant opens a 3-second opportunity. An ordinary hit grants the nearest other colonist within 3 cells a 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per round. No ally preserves only the original deadline. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 25/50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.7.label: Falling Splinters
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.7.description: Real Shatter damage remembers the target cell for 3 seconds. An ordinary hit on another enemy deals 50 damage to at most one enemy within 2 cells of that old cell, once per shatter. Empty ground still spends it. Only the latest Shatter landing is retained; charges do not stack. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.8.label: Cold Opening
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.8.description: After Freeze a Beat actually delays a warmup, remember the victim and your position for 3 seconds. Take a native walking step, then hit that victim ordinarily for 50 extra damage, once per successful delay. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.9.label: Banked Cold
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.9.description: Complete Ice Edge returns against two different enemies within 40 seconds to store one charge for 40 seconds. Your next Frost cast spends it for a 75-point shield lasting 4 seconds. Repeating one victim neither builds it nor renews the counting window. Stored charges do not stack or renew. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.10.label: Cold Link
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.10.description: After Shared Cold’s shield absorbs enemy damage, take at least one native walking step, then land an ordinary hit within 2 cells of its original grant cell within 3 seconds to heal its patient by up to 20 non-permanent injury points, once per round. Patient movement does not move the circle; full health preserves only the original deadline, and teleporting does not count. Refinement: non-permanent injury healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.11.label: Scattered Ice
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.11.description: After Falling Splinters hits, walk 2 cells away from your recorded position and land a close ordinary hit on another victim within 3 seconds for 50 extra damage, once per round. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.12.label: Splinter Mantle
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.12.description: After Falling Splinters hits, grant the nearest other colonist within 4 cells a 50-point shield for 3 seconds. With no ally, grant yourself 25 instead. Once per round. Base rewards: shield 25/50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.13.label: Step the Crack
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.13.description: Real Cold Opening damage prepares one 3-second target-switch opportunity. An ordinary hit on another enemy grants you a 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per opening without renewal. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.14.label: Freeze Behind
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.14.description: After Cold Opening deals damage, walk back within 1 cell of the recorded pre-step position and land an ordinary hit within 3 seconds to heal up to 20 injury points on yourself. Once; teleporting does not count. Refinement: non-permanent injury healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.15.label: Cold Echo
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.15.description: After Banked Cold’s shield absorbs enemy damage, your next Frost ability hit within 40 seconds adds 50 damage to at most two enemies. One opportunity per shield round, without stacking. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.16.label: Cold Shared
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.16.description: When spending Banked Cold actually grants its shield, grant up to two other colonists within 3 cells separate 25-point shields for 3 seconds. A rejected primary grant provides nothing. Base rewards: shield 25. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.17.label: Mended Link
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.17.description: After Cold Link actually heals, grant its patient a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per round. This new layer cannot restart Cold Link. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.18.label: Change the Line
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Frost.nodes.18.description: After Cold Link heals, walk outside 2 cells of the recorded patient position and land a close hit on a different enemy within 3 seconds. Heal another injured ally within 4 cells by up to 20 points, excluding the original patient, once per round. Refinement: non-permanent injury healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.
